_description: Hand-labelled eval corpus for NVIDIA's 2026 Annual Review / 10-K. The doc is ~656 KB markdown, 540 chunks via PyMuPDF parse (born-digital fonted PDF). Mostly text + financial tables; only ~5 actual charts (none routed through chart-OCR because PyMuPDF handled the parse cleanly). Tests prose-retrieval, financial-table extraction, and HARD GATES on real corporate content.
_labelling_rule: ANS queries: _anchor_phrase = distinctive substring (5-12 words) from the chunk with the literal answer; populated via scripts/extend_corpus.py resolve. REF queries: should_refuse=true; relevant_chunk_ids=[].
_purpose: Extension of the eval matrix to a real-world hybrid corpus (financial annual report). Demonstrates the scaffolding workflow (extend_corpus.py) and adds a third corpus to the eval matrix alongside slide-decks (English) and french-course (French).
